title: Every scene a video can have
summary: The test's own video: one of each scene the Videos tab draws, said by Graham with the Recruit and Turbo dropping in.

scenes.title: Welcome
scenes.say: G'day. I'm Graham. This is where the readings from every gauge on the network end up, and where we keep them honest.

scenes.title: The network
scenes.say: Here is how many stations are on file today. Rain gauges, river gauges, and the repeaters that pass their readings on.
scenes.note: Counted from the station list this device has loaded.

scenes.title: Where they are
scenes.say: And here they are on the map, from the coast to well out past the range.

scenes.title: The front page
scenes.say: The front page tells you how the network is right now, and puts the tools you'll reach for most a press away.

callouts.text: How the network is, right now

scenes.title: How the network is
scenes.say: Every morning the network checks itself, and the stations that need a look are listed first.
points: What needs a look, worst first
Batteries that will not last the week
A short video of it every morning

scenes.title: A station's card
scenes.say: So I pick a station on the map, and its card tells me everything about the site?
points: The latest reading and the plot
The site, its photos and the way in

scenes.title: Where to start
scenes.say: If you only open three places this week, make it these.

items.text: The map, to find a station
How the network is, each morning
The videos, when you want to be shown

scenes.title: And plenty more
scenes.say: Flat out, then! Path profiles, link budgets, radio coverage, and exports for Radio Mobile!

scenes.title: That's the lot
scenes.say: That's the start of it. Everything else it does is listed on one page, a line each.
scenes.line: Might as well do it properly.
